BiblicalUsage: 1) to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to build, rebuild; 1a2) to build a house (ie, establish a family); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be built; 1b2) to be rebuilt; 1b3) established (of restored exiles) (fig.); 1b4) established (made permanent); 1b5) to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)
